'''Mahea''' is a continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered by the [[Acrola]] to the north, the [[Hinsakian Ocean]] to the west, [[Kera Sea]], [[Ubrana Sea]] and [[Trayd Cren Sea]] to the east, and the [[Haanian Ocean]] to the south. The continent covers around {{convert|16,973,205|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 5th largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,287,320,000 as of 1765, making it also the 2nd largest continent by population behind [[Massir]].
